title: The structural discrepancy in the immunomodulatory potency of the polysaccharides RFHP-1 and RFHP-2 derived from Radix Fici Hirtae.
authors: Bai, Tiankai; Shi, Zhilong; Bao, Shuguang; Hou, Xiaorong; Zhao, Yuping; Leung, Wai L W; Li, Yuhui; Pan, Sirigunqiqige; Xin, Ying; Luo, Ye; Xiao, Xiaohe; Bai, Laxinamujila; Li, Huifang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究植物多糖RFHP-1/2的免疫调节活性及与MD2蛋白的分子对接，对象为多糖-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Radix Fici Hirtae (RFH), a traditional Chinese medication, is said to be useful in controlling immunity. However, it remained unclear whether its polysaccharides components are associated with these immunomodulatory properties. Herein, two polysaccharides, designated RFHP-1 and RFHP-2, were isolated from RFH using water-soluble alcohol precipitation and column chromatography. Structural characterization by monosaccharide content analysis, methylation, and nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy (NMR) revealed that the main chain of RFHP-1 was formed by the interconnection of -->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->, -->3,6)-beta-D-Glcp-(1-->, -->3)-beta-D-Glcp-(1-->, and -->4,6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->, and the main chain of RFHP-2 was formed by the interconnection of -->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->, -->3,6)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->, -->3)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->, -->4,6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1--> and -->6)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->. Both RFHP-1 and RFHP-2 raised the CD4/CD8 ratio and improved the expression of immune factors in immunocompromised mice. By activating the NF-kappaB pathway (promote phosphorylation of p65 and IkappaB), RFHP-1 and RFHP-2 both promoted release cytokines (NO, TNF-a, IL-6, and IFN-gamma) at RAW 264.7 macrophages. The results of molecular docking (-8.4 kcal/mol vs. -6.0 kcal/mol) and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) (-7.75 kcal/mol vs. -7.46 kcal/mol) demonstrated that RFHP-1 exhibited stronger binding affinity with MD2, suggesting greater immunoactivating potential. These findings indicate that RFHP polysaccharides, particularly RFHP-1, may serve as promising candidates for development as dietary supplements for individuals with compromised immune systems.
abstract_zh: 粗叶榕（Radix Fici Hirtae, RFH）作为一种传统中药，据称在调节免疫方面具有效用。然而，其多糖成分是否与这些免疫调节特性相关尚不清楚。本研究通过水溶性醇沉法和柱色谱法从RFH中分离出两种多糖，命名为RFHP-1和RFHP-2。通过单糖组成分析、甲基化和核磁共振波谱（NMR）进行结构表征，结果显示RFHP-1的主链由-->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->、-->3,6)-beta-D-Glcp-(1-->、-->3)-beta-D-Glcp-(1-->和-->4,6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->相互连接而成，而RFHP-2的主链由-->4)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->、-->3,6)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->、-->3)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->、-->4,6)-alpha-D-Glcp-(1-->和-->6)-beta-D-Galp-(1-->相互连接而成。RFHP-1和RFHP-2均提高了免疫低下小鼠的CD4/CD8比值，并改善了免疫因子的表达。通过激活NF-kappaB通路（促进p65和IkappaB的磷酸化），RFHP-1和RFHP-2均促进了RAW 264.7巨噬细胞释放细胞因子（NO、TNF-a、IL-6和IFN-gamma）。分子对接（-8.4 kcal/mol对比-6.0 kcal/mol）和等温滴定量热法（ITC）（-7.75 kcal/mol对比-7.46 kcal/mol）的结果表明，RFHP-1与MD2表现出更强的结合亲和力，提示其具有更大的免疫激活潜力。这些发现表明，RFHP多糖，尤其是RFHP-1，可能作为开发针对免疫系统受损个体的膳食补充剂的有前景候选物。
